title: 🕵️ Audit Mode — {title}
body: In Audit Mode Aegis records and reports the punishments it would decide on its own — warning steps, the blacklist when someone joins, anti-betrayal — but doesn't carry them out. Commands and panel actions by admins still work. Use it to try settings safely.
state_on: State: ON — automatic punishments are only reported.
state_off: State: OFF — automatic punishments are carried out.
creator_on: ⚠️ {name} turned Audit Mode ON in {title}: automatic punishments are now only reported.
